title: Trees Chosen for Dry Streets
transcript:
A street planting project in Fairhaven is taking a different approach this autumn. Instead of choosing trees mainly for their flowers, the council will plant varieties that can survive long periods with little rain. In the last two summers, young trees along several roads lost their leaves early, even though workers watered them regularly. Replacing them cost more than the original planting programme.

Before selecting the new trees, a small team examined the ground beneath the pavements. They found that many planting spaces were too narrow for roots to spread. The revised project will therefore remove a short section of paving around each tree and fill the space with soil that holds water more effectively. Local gardeners helped test three suitable tree varieties in a nearby school field.

The work will begin on Market Road, where shops have agreed to keep delivery boxes away from the new planting spaces. The council will supply water bags that release water slowly around each trunk. Residents can volunteer to check the bags, but they have been asked not to add plant food because too much could damage the young roots.

The council says the success of the project will not be judged by how attractive the street looks immediately. Staff will check survival and growth over the next three years. Only then will they decide which varieties to plant across the rest of the town.

questions.prompt: What is the main aim when choosing the new trees?
options: To survive long periods without much rain.
To grow tall within a few months.
To attract customers to garden shops.
questions.answer: To survive long periods without much rain.
questions.explanation: 本次选树主要考虑耐旱能力，而非花朵是否好看。

questions.prompt: What problem did the team discover beneath the pavements?
options: Water pipes were leaking into every planting space.
The soil contained too many fallen leaves.
Roots had too little room to spread.
Old tree roots had blocked the entire road.
questions.answer: Roots had too little room to spread.
questions.explanation: 调查发现许多种植空间过窄，树根无法充分伸展。

questions.prompt: What have volunteers been asked not to do?
options: Visit the trees in the morning.
Add plant food around the trees.
questions.answer: Add plant food around the trees.
questions.explanation: 居民可以查看水袋，但不应添加肥料，因为过量可能伤害幼根。

questions.prompt: How will the council assess the project?
options: By monitoring tree survival and growth for three years.
By comparing flower colours after one month.
By counting visitors to the school field.
By measuring how quickly shops receive deliveries.
questions.answer: By monitoring tree survival and growth for three years.
questions.explanation: 委员会将连续三年观察树木存活和生长情况，而非立刻根据街景评估成效。
